correctness.rationale: For smooth generalized Fermat complete intersections of CY type, cited fixed-locus Proposition 3/3.4 yields the exact t+1 exponent threshold. A nonidentity free element must have every k residue exactly t times, ruling out composite k by proper powers. For p prime, Fourier inversion on G^* proves balanced full-character multiplicity m=t/p^(r-1) iff every element acts freely, and the affine-group free orbit computation gives the exact factorial count. Simple connectivity by Lefschetz, canonical-volume invariance by holomorphic Lefschetz and finite étale quotient, and Chern integration prove the fivefold data. The standalone checker exhaustively verifies finite orbit counts and Euler arithmetic, returning VERIFY_OK; infinite assertions rest on algebraic proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of finite subgroups acting freely inside the canonical diagonal group for an entire family of CY manifolds. It establishes a prime/composite obstruction, optimal fundamental-group rank, and an exact count of all labelled subgroups. In fivefold dimension it produces an explicit (Z/3)^2 free action with 840 embedded subgroup choices and quotient Euler characteristic -1080 and Picard rank 1. These answer motivated geometric questions beyond mere single-automorphism freeness.
